240-647-5470-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-647-5470-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2023-4289-4359-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

814-3259-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
814-3259-8201.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

719-4881-6909-6974.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
719-4881-6909-6974.description:
Cast Ashling's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

4247-6662-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1724-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sekki.
When Sekki dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

654-3678-6681-6879.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
There's another land on the battlefield.
654-3678-6681-6879.description:
Play Strip Mine.
When Strip Mine enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Strip Mine.
Activate Strip Mine's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, targeting another land.
Haru triggers, returning Strip Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Strip Mine enters, Retreat to Emeria and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Strip Mine.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
654-3678-6681-6879.notes: You can use this combo as a lock, destroying any lands you wish as they enter. To do this combo infinitely, simply target the same land each loop while keeping the Strip Mine abilities on the stack.

140-3591-7433.description:
Activate Necropotence by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 4 or greater

3869-4067-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}{U}
Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Mona Lisa.
Repeat.

3573-4499-7008.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five artifacts.
3573-4499-7008.description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying {1}{G}.
When Badgermole Cub enters, it triggers, earthbending Tolarian Academy.
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Tolarian Academy.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Badgermole Cub.
Repeat from step 2.

3967-4605-4681-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {5}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Karmic Guide and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7159.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2033-3490-6965-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
2033-3490-6965-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

104-1086-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1086-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

2665-4600-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
2665-4600-7009.description:
Activate either Progenitor Mimic or Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat using the Avatar Kuruk token.

56-5256-6255-6887.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-5256-6255-6887.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, The Skullspore Nexus and Zahur trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-5256-6255-6887.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

1850-1863-5414.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-1863-5414.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

2281-3305-6798.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Body Launderer.
When Saffi dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

222-527-4927-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4927-6797.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

723-4067-4825.description:
Activate Captain Sisay by tapping it, searching your library for Emrakul and putting it into your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Emrakul.
Emrakul triggers, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Captain Sisay.
Repeat.

2178-3362-5231-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
2178-3362-5231-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the Dragon with mana value 6 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Bladewing.
When Bladewing dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Repeat.

510-2281-4050.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Mistmoon Griffin.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mistmoon Griffin, adding one mana of any color.
When Mistmoon Griffin dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Mistmoon Griffin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Mistmoon Griffin trigger, failing to exile it as it is not in your graveyard and then returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2835-5686-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2835-5686-6249--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Fecundity trigger.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

238-1365-1477-2438.notablePrerequisites: Gerrard has no more than one -1/-1 counter on it.
238-1365-1477-2438.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Gerrard persist until end of turn.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Cauldron of Souls, putting a +1/+1 counter on Gerrard.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gerrard.
When Gerrard dies, it and its persist ability trigger.
Resolve the Gerrard persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Gerrard trigger, failing to exile it as it has left your graveyard, and returning Cauldron of Souls from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 3, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2034-3374-5263.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero, adding {C}{C}.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader, adding {C}{C}.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2557-2972-5456.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Treasures.
2557-2972-5456.description:
Activate Magda by sacrificing three Treasures, creating two 4/4 Scorpion Dragon creature tokens with flying and haste.
When the Scorpion Dragons enter the battlefield, Ganax triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Repeat.

509-3525-4851.notablePrerequisites:
Idris does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Idris.
509-3525-4851.description:
Activate Idris using Timeless Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Idris.
Repeat.

876-2034-2557-2703.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Myr Propagator.
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating two token copies of itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the tapped Myr Propagator and a Myr Propagator token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-456-2100-2440.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Dragons and/or Illusions.
392-456-2100-2440.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {4}{R}.
Birgi and Manaform Hellkite trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Manaform Hellkite trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon Illusion creature token with haste.
The Dragon Illusion enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Searing Touch to your hand.
Repeat.

186-4131-4241.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
186-4131-4241.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt's Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat step 1 and 3.

2-3003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.
2-3003.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {0}.
Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

239-1763-4385-4893.description:
All slivers have haste.
Tap a Sliver to generate {1}.
Use that mana to create a Sliver with Sliver Queen's ability.
Use the newly created Sliver to repeat the cycle.

2914-4992.description: Stormtide makes everything an island, choke prevents them from untapping
